description: Source code for the FreeType Cache Manager, implementing cache handling, face and size node management, and cache manager routines.

methods.name: ftc_scaler_lookup_size
methods.description: Looks up or creates a size object for a given scaler within the cache manager.

methods.name: ftc_size_node_done
methods.description: Callback to free size node resources.

methods.name: ftc_size_node_compare
methods.description: Compares size nodes with a scaler for cache lookup.

methods.name: ftc_size_node_init
methods.description: Initializes a size node with scaler info.

methods.name: ftc_size_node_reset
methods.description: Resets a size node with new scaler info.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_LookupSize
methods.description: Retrieves a size object from the cache manager based on scaler.

methods.name: ftc_face_node_init
methods.description: Initializes a face node by requesting a face from the manager.

methods.name: ftc_face_node_done
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a face node.

methods.name: ftc_face_node_compare
methods.description: Compares face nodes by face ID.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_LookupFace
methods.description: Retrieves a face object from the cache manager by face ID.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_New
methods.description: Creates a new cache manager with specified limits and request callback.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_Done
methods.description: Frees all resources associated with the cache manager.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_Reset
methods.description: Resets the cache manager, clearing size and face lists.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_Check
methods.description: Debug function to verify cache manager integrity.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_Compress
methods.description: Removes unused cache nodes to limit total memory usage.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_RegisterCache
methods.description: Registers a new cache type with the manager.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_FlushN
methods.description: Removes a specified number of cache nodes.

methods.name: FTC_Manager_RemoveFaceID
methods.description: Removes all cache entries associated with a face ID.

methods.name: FTC_Node_Unref
methods.description: Decrements reference count of a cache node.
